name: Camp Awosting
description_short: Camp Awosting is an overnight summer camp for boys in Morris, Connecticut, with sessions from 1 to 8 weeks between June 27 and August 21, 2027. Tuition covers meals, snacks, laundry, towel service, gratuities, the canteen shop and all on-camp activities.
refund_policy_summary: Half of the deposit cannot be refunded under any circumstances, and the whole deposit becomes non-refundable after 12/31/26. Balances are due May 1. Unused canteen money is not refunded. Families in the Guaranteed Tuition Program pay no deposit; they pay half the tuition by November 15 and half by January 15.

warnings: The session prices recorded are Early Bird rates, which are 'open until November 15, 2026'. After that, regular rates apply: 1 week $2,755; 2 weeks $5,360; 3 weeks $7,270; 4 weeks $9,180; 6 weeks $11,435; 8 weeks $13,230.
price_min is the lowest Early Bird rate and price_max is the highest regular rate.
This page covers only the boys' overnight camp. The camp also runs a day camp, whose prices and sessions are on a separate page and are not included here.
Availability is marked 'open' because enrollment has started, but the page says 'enrollment is normally full by the end of January.'

There are extra costs on top of tuition. The canteen fee runs from $80 to $250 depending on session length. Optional extras include airport transportation ($250 each way), the international package ($600), linen and trunk rental ($200–$250), the senior trip ($650), changeover day trips ($100) and the visiting day trip ($50).
The camp email address is hidden on the page ('[email protected]'), so no email was recorded.
